sections.Profile:
"Seven Seas" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1960. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, and two bullseye targets.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
